requirement: The exceptions queue durable read orders by ts DESC (backed by ix_events_kind_ts) and paginates by a before_ts keyset so its bounded page retains the FRESHEST exception.raised/osd.captured events rather than a lexicographic-by-stream_id slice — closing the WP-10 exit-audit 5.1 where readEvents ORDER BY stream_id seq truncated at LIMIT 1000 BEFORE the JS ts-sort so an open exception past 1000 lifetime exception events could silently vanish from the queue (contradicting the never-lose-an-exception contract); the ledger stays intact (GET /v1/shipments/:id/events always surfaces the durable event) so this is a read-view completeness fix
dod_test: With over 1000 lifetime exception events a fresh open exception still appears in GET /v1/exceptions and older pages are reachable by the before_ts cursor

requirement: The R2 retention RE-INSTATE (a re-upload of a retention-tombstoned document) restarts the retention clock from the RE-SUBMISSION time (a wall-clock now) NOT the original over-1yr-old capture-event recorded_at — closing the WP-11 exit-audit finding A where evidence.ts bound recording.recorded_at (already past its retention) so the next sweep tick re-deleted the freshly re-uploaded bytes and the uploader got a false 200; POD/pod-7yr evidence is sweep-excluded and never reaches this path so only a re-uploaded over-1yr-old default doc was affected (liveness not correctness/money/isolation)
dod_test: A re-uploaded tombstoned default doc keeps its bytes for a full retention window after re-submission and is not re-deleted on the next sweep
